posts.text: There’s no cure for ADHD, but there’s peace in working *with* it.
Minority ADHD is being told you’re dramatic for struggling to function.
The ADHD urge treats every idea like an emergency but somehow, I still pull it off.
My ADHD brain doesn’t forget things. It just postpones them until the guilt hits.
ADHD partners don’t forget people—they forget tasks. You feel this too?
My ADHD budget has a section for ‘oops.’ Anyone else? Anyone else?
